intro: The Agekeeper deals cards in this order. Determine all Bonus Cards before dealing any.

steps.label: Base Harvest
steps.body: Agekeeper deals 2 cards face-down to each player from the Common Deck.

steps.label: Agekeeper's Boon
steps.body: If the Agekeeper's rolled Sign exactly matches the Cosmic Age Sign, all players receive +2 additional Harvest cards.

steps.label: Calculate Bonus Cards
steps.body: Each player tallies Bonus Cards using Alignment (Sign +3, Planet +2, Element +1 per source; highest Aspect only per source).

steps.label: Deal Bonus Cards
steps.body: Agekeeper deals each player their Bonus Cards, one at a time, face-down.
